remarks: Welcome home to 85 Lindale Street, 2. Conveniently located on a picturesque block, this charming 1-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom duplex is part of a collection of 7 condos, offered at the Lindale Manor.  Spanning 675 square feet, this home features a perfect blend of classic elegance and modern convenience. Enter through the foyer to the living space accentuated by inviting bay windows, gorgeous crown molding, high ceilings, and gleaming hardwood floors throughout. An abundance of natural light illuminates the apartment creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The kitchen is equipped with stylish cabinetry and stainless steel appliances, perfect for both everyday meals and entertaining guests. The upper level is complete with a half bathroom, modern lighting, crawl space for storage, and decorative stairwell.  The lower level features a private, oversized bedroom boasting French doors that open to a tranquil atmosphere. The bedroom easily accommodates a king-size bed, nightstands, and dressers. The en-suite bathroom offers gorgeous tile, vanity, and multiple fixtures. A walk-in closet completes the primary bedroom. The lower level provides a full-size washer and dryer as well as additional storage under the stairs.   The home will come with one reserved parking space in the driveway, and ample free street parking is also available. Located on a charming block, this condo is within a short 10-minute walk to the vibrant restaurants and amenities of Downtown Stamford.
